title: On the MRT
scene: A crowded MRT carriage where a teenager gives up his reserved seat to a pregnant woman while other passengers stare at their phones.
questions: Describe what is happening in this picture.
Why do you think the other passengers did not offer their seats?
Tell me about a time someone was kind to you in public.
Should reserved seats only be for people who need them? Why?
What makes a person a considerate commuter?
